notes.title: Free App Announcement
notes.content: [p]Dear customer:[/p][p]We have received a lot of customer feedback recently that the application may experience issues such as black screen and flashing when used. We are very sorry for this. Therefore, this application was released earlier and is no longer able to provide technical support, resulting in the application not being able to match mainstream VR hardware devices well. Therefore, this application will soon be changed to a free application for communication purposes only.[/p][p]We would like to express our sincere gratitude and apologies to our customers.[/p]
